<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_rel_widget_clone"><sp_rel_widget_clone action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><child display_value="Copy of To-dos header Widget">af0dded947352e10713b52e1d16d43e3</child><cloned>2025-05-28 05:18:28</cloned><last_validated>2025-05-28 05:18:28</last_validated><parent display_value="To-dos header Widget">e3d78e3e5b6b13001109efe5f0f91acb</parent><payload><?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><sp_widget><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[function($scope, $sce, $sanitize) {
	var c = this;
	$scope.data.displayValueList[0] = $sce.trustAsHtml($sanitize($scope.data.displayValueList[0]));
	$scope.data.displayValueList[1] = $sce.trustAsHtml($sanitize($scope.data.displayValueList[1]));
}
    ]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>.todo-summary-cell {
	position: relative;
  margin-bottom: 0;
  border: none;
  box-shadow:none;
  border-bottom: 1px solid $border;
	.todo-summary-body {
		padding-top: 10px;
		padding-bottom: 10px;
		display: flex;
    align-items:center;
    min-height:82px;
		.todo-summary-details {
			overflow: hidden;
			text-align: left !important;
      margin-right: 15px;
      .task-title {
        font-size: 1.5rem;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
        overflow: hidden;
        white-space: nowrap;
			}
      .case-title {
        font-size: 1.4rem;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
        color:$color-darkest;
        overflow: hidden;
        white-space: nowrap;
      }
      .text-muted {
        font-size: 1.4rem;
      }
      .todo-status {
      	padding-top:10px;
      }
      .fa-check-circle {
				padding-right: 1px;
        padding-left: 1px;
			}
		}
    .todo-summary-icon {
      display: flex;
    	vertical-align: middle;
    	padding: 0 0 0 15px;
    	font-size: 1.82rem;
      justify-content: center;
      .fa-level-up {
        color: $color-light;
        transform: rotate(90deg);
        vertical-align: -webkit-baseline-middle;
        margin-right: 15px;
    	} 
    }
  }
}


/*Increasing width for childern tasks*/
.todo-summary-body{
  .indent-xsm {
    padding-left: 48px !important;
  }

  .indent-xs {
    padding-left: 0px;
  }
}


/* IE Fixes */
@media screen and (-ms-high-contrast: active), (-ms-high-contrast: none) {  
  .todo-summary-body {
    .indent-xs {
      width: 5em;
    }	
  }
}
</css><data_table>sp_instance</data_table><demo_data/><description>This widget contains 3 rows that correspond to the 3 fields defined in the configuration.
For HR task show the following information:

Due Date

</description><docs/><field_list/><has_preview>true</has_preview><id>hrm-todos-header-widget</id><internal>false</internal><link/><name>To-dos header Widget</name><option_schema/><public>false</public><roles/><script><![CDATA[(function() {
	var fields = ['sysId', 'tableName', 'displayValueList', 'dueDateDisplayValue', 'level', 'onTicketPage', 'isCompleted', 'hasDueDate'];
	function copyFields(from) {
		var field;
		for (var x in fields) {
			field = fields[x];
			if (!gs.nil(from[field])) {
				data[field] = from[field];
			}
		}
	}
	if (input) {
		copyFields(input);
	}
	if (options) {
		copyFields(options);
	}
})();]]></script><servicenow>false</servicenow><sys_class_name>sp_widget</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2018-07-30 21:02:03</sys_created_on><sys_id>e3d78e3e5b6b13001109efe5f0f91acb</sys_id><sys_mod_count>282</sys_mod_count><sys_name>To-dos header Widget</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Employee Center Core" source="sn_hr_sp">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Employee Center Core">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_widget_e3d78e3e5b6b13001109efe5f0f91acb</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2021-11-21 19:26:46</sys_updated_on><template><![CDATA[<div class="todo-summary-cell">
      <div class="todo-summary-body">
        <div class="todo-summary-icon" ng-class="{'indent-xsm':data.level == 2,'indent-xs':data.level == 1 }">
          <span ng-if="data.onTicketPage && (data.level == 1 || data.level == 2)"><i class="fa fa-level-up"></i></span>
        </div>
        <div class="todo-summary-details">
          <div class="task-title"> 
            <a href="javascript:void(0);" role="link" aria-label="{{data.displayValueList[0]}}" ng-bind-html="data.displayValueList[0]"></a>
          </div>
          <div ng-if="data.displayValueList[1]&&( data.isCompleted || !data.onTicketPage) " class="case-title" aria-label="{{data.displayValueList[1]}}"> 
            <i ng-if="data.isCompleted && data.onTicketPage" class="fa fa-check-circle"></i><div ng-bind-html="data.displayValueList[1]"></div>
          </div>

          <div ng-if="data.dueDateDisplayValue" class="text-muted" ng-class="{'todo-status': !data.onTicketPage}">
            <span aria-label="{{data.dueDateDisplayValue}}">
            	<i ng-if="data.isCompleted" class="fa fa-check-circle success"></i> {{data.isCompleted && data.hasDueDate ? '${Completed}' : data.dueDateDisplayValue}}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
  	</div>
</div>
]]></template></sp_widget></payload><sys_class_name>sp_rel_widget_clone</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-05-28 05:18:28</sys_created_on><sys_id>ab0d9e1d47352e10713b52e1d16d4324</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>af0dded947352e10713b52e1d16d43e3</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Demo" source="x_58872_needit">6ead8e780f603200cd674f8ce1050ed1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Demo">6ead8e780f603200cd674f8ce1050ed1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_rel_widget_clone_ab0d9e1d47352e10713b52e1d16d4324</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-05-28 05:18:28</sys_updated_on></sp_rel_widget_clone></record_update>
